response.overview: Semi, who is writing a novel in the library, draws images of the main characters in her notebook when her writing is not well done. In front of Semi, she sees a girl (On) who is similar to the picture, and she gets hurt in many places on her body. When she writes a novel while looking at On, she writes well, and Semi wants to get close to On. On a rainy day, the two become close by getting hurt. Semi has to make On unhappy like the main character in the novel, but as time goes by, she feels guilty about On's warmth and problems arise between the two.
response.title: The girls in an imperfect season
